decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'automatic page metadata are excluded from this initial release'. R1 client: 'The app should fill in the details for me... go grab the page's title, its description, its little icon, and ideally a preview image automatically. I can then tweak any of that before or after saving if it got it wrong... one of the parts I care about most.'
decisions.note: Reference requires auto-collection of title/description/favicon/preview (REF-BM-02) and editing before/after save (REF-BM-03); maker explicitly excluded metadata. Client rejects the exclusion and supplies the conforming behaviour. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope omits read-later ('supporting save, search, tags, sorting, editing, opening, and deletion'). R1 client: "'Read it later' is missing entirely... mark a link as unread/to-read, and be able to look at just my unread ones in their own place, then mark them read once I'm done so they drop off that list."
decisions.note: Read-later mark/unread view/mark-read (REF-BM-17/18/19) absent from presented scope; client requests the missing reference requirement. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits archiving. R1 client: 'Archiving, separate from deleting... "put away" a link — hide it from my normal list and searches but keep it around... That's different from deletion, and I'd want a separate place to see the archived ones.'
decisions.note: Archive as reversible hide (REF-BM-26), distinct from delete (REF-BM-27), separate archive list (REF-BM-28) absent; client requests them. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker scope lists only plain 'search'. R1 client: 'Smarter searching... search by tag with something like #tagname, to combine conditions (this AND that, one OR another, exclude something), and to search an exact phrase by putting it in quotes.'
decisions.note: Tag search #tag (REF-BM-14), AND/OR/NOT+groups (REF-BM-15), quoted-phrase exact match (REF-BM-16) absent; client requests them. REF-BM-12 plain full-text was already in scope. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits bulk actions. R1 client: 'Doing things to several links at once... select a bunch of links and, in one go, tag them, mark them read/unread, archive them, or delete them.'
decisions.note: Multi-select bulk action (REF-BM-20) absent; client requests it. REF-BM-21 (apply to whole filtered collection) was not separately elicited and no distinct presentation of it exists, so it is not classified here. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits notes. R1 client: 'writing a longer formatted note on a link and having it show nicely when I view it.' Framed as an 'eventually' item but still requested ('Could you revise the spec to bring these in').
decisions.note: Markdown note with rendering (REF-BM-23) absent; client expresses the requirement and asks it be folded in (ordering deferred to maker, but inclusion requested). Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits saved searches/bundles. R1 client: 'saving a search-plus-tag combination so I can reuse it later.'
decisions.note: Bundle = saved search+tags for reuse (REF-BM-29) absent; client requests it. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'imports... browser extensions... are excluded'. R1 client: 'bringing bookmarks in from a browser file and sending mine back out.'
decisions.note: Netscape import (REF-BM-30) explicitly excluded and export (REF-BM-31) absent; client rejects the exclusion and describes the conforming behaviour. Browser extensions (REF-BM-I04) is infra and excluded from analysis. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker omits display settings. R1 client: 'a few display preferences like default sort order and text size.'
decisions.note: Display personal settings (default sort/font size, REF-BM-32) absent; client requests them. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R2 revised spec (maker) covers metadata/search/read-later/archive/bulk/notes/saved-searches/import-export but not offline copies. R2 client: 'keeping my own readable copy of a saved page... when I save a bookmark, I'd want the app to also keep a copy of that page as it looked... in the case where the link points at a PDF... keep the PDF itself rather than a copy of a webpage.' R3 maker folds it in.
decisions.note: Local snapshot as single-file page plus the PDF-instead-of-HTML rule (REF-BM-24) was omitted from the R2 presented scope; client requests the missing reference requirement including the PDF edge case. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker offline-copy presentation enumerates local capture: 'Readable, visually recognizable offline captures... Retention of the original file for PDF links... Offline access when the source changes or disappears' — no Internet Archive snapshot. R3 client: 'That's exactly what I wanted... The whole spec now lines up... please go ahead to the implementation plan' with no mention of Internet Archive.
decisions.note: Reference includes creating a snapshot on the Internet Archive (REF-BM-25) as a distinct snapshot capability. The R3 presentation squarely covers the snapshot domain but omits REF-BM-25; the client approved without expressing this difference. Never surfaced by anyone in R1-R6. Approval alone does not establish whether the client noticed. Specification gate.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker delivers built app. R6 client: 'When I tried saving the same link twice it wouldn't let me make a duplicate.'
decisions.note: Re-saving an existing url converges to preventing a duplicate (REF-BM-06 / edge case). Client verified conforming behaviour in the built app. Conforming decision recorded at implementation review; not a divergence.

decisions.evidence: R6 client: 'Searching works nicely — I found things by a tag with #, it didn't care about capitalization, and combining terms and excluding a word both behaved the way I'd want.'
decisions.note: Case-insensitive search (REF-BM-13) verified conforming in the built app; also re-confirms REF-BM-14/15 behaviour. Conforming; implementation review.
